definition.name: PLC and I/O module
definition.description: A powered logic block maps wired permissive inputs to real output contacts.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: Declared control-supply input for this powered electronics block. The lesson uses its stated nominal control voltage; the L/N identifiers do not prescribe a 240 V connection.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: Control-supply return reference for this powered electronics block. The lesson uses its stated nominal control voltage; the L/N identifiers do not prescribe a 240 V connection.

terminals.label: I1
terminals.purpose: I1 permissive input sensed relative to N at half the declared control voltage. The selected AND/OR/independent/latch teaching logic combines actual wired input states; it is not a free-floating software checkbox.

terminals.label: I2
terminals.purpose: I2 permissive input sensed relative to N at half the declared control voltage. The selected AND/OR/independent/latch teaching logic combines actual wired input states; it is not a free-floating software checkbox.

terminals.label: COM
terminals.purpose: Common supply for both conceptual PLC output contacts. A powered PLC does not supply this terminal automatically; wire the intended output voltage here.

terminals.label: Q1
terminals.purpose: Q1 switched contact from COM. Q1 follows the selected logic mode. This is a declared contact-output abstraction, not a universal PLC transistor-output wiring scheme.

terminals.label: Q2
terminals.purpose: Q2 switched contact from COM. Q2 follows input I2 independently. This is a declared contact-output abstraction, not a universal PLC transistor-output wiring scheme.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Electronic control board
parts.purpose: This conceptual board represents an electronic interface. The model follows stated input, output and power limits rather than reconstructing proprietary firmware.

parts.name: Display and indicators
parts.purpose: The display reports the model operating state. Meter readings come from the connected circuit, not a pre-recorded picture.
